Places: Photon (komoot), OpenStreetMap data; the query and the map's area are sent there. Coordinates stay on this page.

    Layers

    Charts

    Not for navigation. Positions, depths and coastlines come from open datasets of varying accuracy; depths are a coarse elevation model, not soundings.

    Each layer's source, licence and resolution are behind its ⓘ in the Layers panel.

    Tile requests tell each provider which area you are viewing; a hidden layer makes none.

    Keys

    • / search · L layers
    • R ruler · A area · C range ring
    • Enter or double-click finishes · Backspace undoes · Esc cancels
